proposal.title: Barnaby the Dog and Miki the Mouse and the Sunlit Ball Duel
proposal.question: Can Barnaby the dog prioritize his friend Miki's safety over winning a competitive game of ball in the village square?
proposal.answer: Barnaby chooses to abandon the game to help Miki, proving that their bond is far more valuable than a simple sporting victory.

story_beats.headline: The Competitive Start
story_beats.speech: Barnaby and Miki watch the bright red ball bounce wildly across the village square, each waiting for the perfect chance to pounce.
story_beats.label: Village Square Clearing
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby the dog and Miki the mouse stand alert in a sunny village square forest clearing, staring at a red ball sitting between them.

story_beats.headline: The Dangerous Trap
story_beats.speech: Miki rushes toward the ball but stops abruptly as a heavy wooden gate swings shut, pinning his tail against the rough frame.
story_beats.label: Wooden Gate Frame
story_beats.visual_prompt: Miki the mouse looks distressed as his tail is caught under the bottom edge of a large wooden gate door in the village square.

story_beats.headline: The Crucial Decision

story_beats.label: Barnaby Saving Miki
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby the dog uses his snout to push the wooden gate door open, while Miki the mouse waits nervously with his tail freed.

story_beats.headline: A Friend Rewarded
story_beats.speech: After Miki is safe, Barnaby gently nudges the ball back to him, choosing cooperation over the thrill of winning the competitive game today.

proposal.decisive_choice: Barnaby chooses to stop chasing the ball to nudge the heavy gate open and free Miki's trapped tail.
proposal.resolution: Barnaby lets Miki have the ball, and they play together gently instead of competing, strengthening their friendship despite the initial tension.

proposal.title: Barnaby the Owl and the Observatory Dial Confusion
proposal.question: Does the flickering lantern light mean the observatory clock is broken or merely reflecting the passing night birds?
proposal.answer: Barnaby tests his theory by shielding the lantern, realizing the clock face was just mimicking the rhythmic light of the forest.

story_beats.headline: The Flickering Discovery
story_beats.speech: My goodness, the clock face is wobbling like a leaf in the wind. Is the inner gear truly coming loose tonight?
story_beats.label: observatory
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby the Owl stands inside a dimly lit stone observatory, looking intensely at a large wooden clock on the wall while holding a glowing lantern.

story_beats.headline: The Mounting Suspicion
story_beats.speech: Every time my lantern flame dances, the clock hands seem to twitch. I must stop this wobble before it breaks down.
story_beats.label: observatory interior
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby the Owl holds his lantern high, casting long, wavering shadows across the observatory wall that make the clock hands appear to move erratically.

story_beats.headline: The Measured Choice
story_beats.speech: If I put the lantern down, will the clock face stay still? I must be certain before I touch the gears.
story_beats.label: observatory workspace
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby the Owl reaches out with his wing to cover the lantern, deciding to test the source of the shadow movement before acting impulsively.

story_beats.headline: The Silent Clarity
story_beats.speech: The clock is steady as stone. It was only my own light playing tricks on my eyes. I am relieved now.
story_beats.label: observatory window
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby the Owl stands in the now-dark observatory, looking at the perfectly still clock while the moonlight illuminates the room, proving his previous error.

proposal.central_conflict: Barnaby the Owl mistakenly believes the observatory clock is malfunctioning because its shadow appears to jitter in sync with his lantern's flickering glow.
proposal.decisive_choice: Barnaby chooses to extinguish his lantern to see if the clock's shadow stops moving, rather than attempting to pry open the clock casing.
proposal.resolution: With the lantern dark, the clock remains perfectly still, proving the movement was an optical illusion, preventing Barnaby from damaging the delicate timepiece.

proposal.title: Tobias the Tapir and the Meadow Flower Balance
proposal.question: Can Tobias understand why the sunlight-sensitive flowers are closing before sunset?
proposal.answer: Tobias realizes the tall flower blocks the light of the smaller one, so he gently moves it.

story_beats.headline: A Curious Discovery
story_beats.speech: Tobias the tapir gazes at the two flowers with great concern as the star-flower petals begin to curl and fold tight.
story_beats.label: Flower Observation
story_beats.visual_prompt: Tobias the tapir stands in a lush sunlit forest clearing, looking down at a small star-flower wilting near a tall, vibrant bell-flower.

story_beats.headline: The Shadow Theory
story_beats.speech: The tapir wonders if the taller bell-flower is stealing all the golden light away from his tiny, fragile friend today.
story_beats.label: Analyzing Light
story_beats.visual_prompt: Tobias the tapir tilts his head in a forest clearing, observing how the long shadow of the bell-flower falls directly over the small star-flower.

story_beats.headline: A Gentle Adjustment
story_beats.speech: Tobias pushes the bell-flower stem with his snout to move it away, hoping this simple shift helps his small floral friend.
story_beats.label: Physical Correction
story_beats.visual_prompt: Tobias the tapir uses his nose to gently nudge the stem of the tall bell-flower in the forest clearing, clearing the path for direct light.

story_beats.headline: The Floral Revival
story_beats.speech: The star-flower blossoms again under the warm sun rays, proving to Tobias that his kind act saved the day for everyone.
story_beats.label: Successful Restoration
story_beats.visual_prompt: Tobias the tapir smiles in the forest clearing as the small star-flower fully opens its petals under the returning direct sunlight.

proposal.central_conflict: A tall bell-flower casts a shadow that causes a smaller neighboring star-flower to prematurely close its petals.
proposal.decisive_choice: Tobias chooses to carefully nudge the tall bell-flower aside with his nose instead of leaving the smaller flower in shadow.
proposal.resolution: The star-flower reopens as sunlight reaches it, confirming the shadow was the cause of the closure.

proposal.title: Pip the Mouse and Clover the Rabbit and the Library Page
proposal.question: How can a mouse and rabbit settle a disagreement over a torn library page without ruining the book?
proposal.answer: By pausing to examine the author's original stitch marks, revealing the page is actually an accidental fold rather than a tear.

story_beats.headline: The Disputed Tear
story_beats.speech: Look right here, Clover! This page is completely torn right down the middle of the illustration.
story_beats.label: library
story_beats.visual_prompt: Pip the mouse stands on a wooden library table pointing at an open book with a troubled expression, while Clover the rabbit sits beside him peering closely at the page.

story_beats.headline: The Suspicious Crease
story_beats.speech: Wait, Pip, before you declare it ruined, let us check the binding threads to see if it was folded.
story_beats.label: library
story_beats.visual_prompt: Clover the rabbit reaches out a gentle paw to touch the edge of the book page inside the quiet library room while Pip the mouse watches attentively.

story_beats.headline: The Thread Inspection
story_beats.speech: The stitching shows no broken fibers at all. It is definitely just a clever fold tucked inside.
story_beats.label: library
story_beats.visual_prompt: Pip the mouse holds a magnifying glass over the book's center crease on the library table, illuminated by a warm lamp while Clover watches with a relieved smile.

story_beats.headline: The Hidden Map
story_beats.speech: Look at that! Unfolding it reveals a secret map of the library's oldest reading nooks.
story_beats.label: library
story_beats.visual_prompt: Pip the mouse and Clover the rabbit both lean back in amazement as a large illustrated paper map unfolds entirely across the wooden library table.

proposal.central_conflict: Pip the Mouse believes a library book page is permanently torn in half, while Clover the Rabbit insists it is an intentional fold.
proposal.decisive_choice: Pip chooses to gently lift the corner with his paw to trace the crease rather than pulling it apart to prove his point.
proposal.resolution: The page unfolds smoothly to reveal a hidden map, ending their dispute and offering a new adventure.
